scope: Controlled termination of exactly attributed R4X main/worker stack exhaustion, using the existing process exit and reaper owners.

design.boundary: Retain a private callback-abort Frame on the original resident kernel task stack before entering module code. Only an IF-on, DF-clear caller publishes it. Existing driver callback entry remains unchanged.
design.fault_admission: Only page-fault error 0/2 with original IF on and DF clear; no memory/runtime owner, preempt disable, held lock, unwind guard, pending handoff or spawn transaction. Require the exact running task/CPU, pinned thread/instance generations and a live execution boundary.
design.bounds: Fault address must be inside this main/worker reservation's terminal 4096-byte guard, with interrupted RSP inside the same reserve and at most one page away. RIP belongs to its exact module image or retained imported R4L.
design.healthy_return: Frame and saved return stack must lie on the retained resident kernel task stack, preserve SysV alignment, leave at least 32 KB below RSP and return to kernel text. Restore its callee registers and MXCSR/x87 controls through the existing assembly resume boundary.
design.retirement: Rewrite only the admitted IRET to that boundary. Later, on the healthy kernel stack, enter the existing thread/process exit owner with failed reason and code -4096. Existing stop, completion and resource-release acknowledgements remain mandatory; module epilogues are abandoned.
design.fallback: Unclear ownership, kernel/driver stacks, critical contexts, non-guard faults, protection faults and VM/physical-budget failures retain the terminal path.
design.abi: No public API/ABI, reserve, initial commit or kernel stack-size change. Private Thread tail grows from 320 to 336 bytes; existing prefix offsets stay fixed.

validation.harness_correction: The first validator scanned ordinary boot counters and rejected failed=0/default missing-device messages. Scope failure matching to the explicit diagnostic window and real failure/ERRORLEVEL markers; revalidate the same captured guest without rerunning it.
validation.image_inventory_order: Initial image preparation stopped before building: new report entry was appended outside deterministic Path/Name order. Insert it after KernelStack0843, then rerun image preparation; runtime artifacts unchanged.
validation.comparison_limit: One final STANDARD per subversion; score changes are descriptive single-run observations.

performance_assessment: The normal module-entry boundary and private thread records change, so exactly one final Suite-2 STANDARD on SMP4 is required.
limits: Only exactly admitted terminal reserve exhaustion is recoverable; this does not make arbitrary exceptions recoverable.
Windows host and physical hardware are not exercised.
